title: VIP Chapter 2 Week 2: Geological Processes and Landforms

questions.text: Adigrat Sandstone was deposited during which era?
questions.explanation: Adigrat Sandstone = Mesozoic era (225-70 million years ago).

questions.text: Antalo Limestone indicates Ethiopia was once covered by:
questions.explanation: Limestone forms in marine environments — evidence of ancient shallow seas.

questions.text: The Trap Series basalts were formed by:
questions.explanation: Trap Series = thick volcanic basalt layers from Cenozoic lava flows.

questions.text: The Rift Valley is getting WIDER because:
options: B) Tectonic plates are pulling apart
questions.correct_answer: B) Tectonic plates are pulling apart
questions.explanation: The Rift Valley widens a few mm per year as tectonic forces pull the crust apart.

questions.text: Which lake is in Ethiopia's Rift Valley?
questions.explanation: Lake Abaya is in the Rift Valley. Lake Tana is in the highlands. Victoria/Malawi are outside Ethiopia.

questions.text: Erta Ale volcano is located in:
questions.explanation: Erta Ale is an active volcano in the Afar Rift Valley.

questions.text: Precambrian rocks are BEST exposed in:
questions.explanation: Precambrian basement rocks are exposed in northern (Tigray) and western (Wollega) Ethiopia.

questions.text: GONDWANALAND was:
questions.explanation: Gondwanaland = southern supercontinent that broke up during Mesozoic.

questions.text: The Ethiopian Plateaus are SEPARATED by:
questions.explanation: The Rift Valley separates the Western and Eastern Plateaus.

questions.text: Quaternary volcanism in Ethiopia is EVIDENCED by:
options: B) Active volcanoes (Erta Ale) and hot springs (Dallol)
questions.correct_answer: B) Active volcanoes (Erta Ale) and hot springs (Dallol)
questions.explanation: Active volcanoes and hot springs prove ongoing Quaternary volcanism.

questions.text: The lowest point in Ethiopia is:
questions.explanation: Dallol is about 125m BELOW sea level — lowest point in Ethiopia.

questions.text: Peneplanation during the Paleozoic means:
options: B) Wearing down of mountains to flat surfaces
questions.correct_answer: B) Wearing down of mountains to flat surfaces
questions.explanation: Peneplanation = erosion reducing mountains to nearly flat plains.

questions.text: The break-up of Gondwanaland began during:
questions.explanation: Gondwanaland break-up started during Mesozoic (225-70 million years ago).

questions.text: Ethiopia's Rift Valley is part of:
options: A) The Great African Rift System
questions.correct_answer: A) The Great African Rift System
questions.explanation: Ethiopia's Rift is part of the Great African Rift System spanning from Middle East to Mozambique.

questions.text: The Blue Nile Gorge was carved by:
questions.explanation: The Blue Nile River eroded the gorge through millions of years (exogenic process).

questions.text: Which rock type is the YOUNGEST in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Quaternary (last 2.6 million years) volcanic rocks are the youngest.

questions.text: The Afar region is known for:
questions.explanation: Afar = one of the most geologically active places on Earth.

questions.text: Fossils of early marine life (trilobites) are found in Ethiopia's:
questions.explanation: Paleozoic sedimentary rocks contain marine fossils like trilobites.

questions.text: Ethiopia's HIGHEST point (Ras Dashen) is made of:
questions.explanation: Ras Dashen (4,550m) is composed of Cenozoic volcanic rocks.

questions.text: The Rift Valley lakes were formed by:
questions.explanation: Rift Valley lakes formed in the tectonic depression as water collected.
